title: X now compares each reader with their own normal
dek: A new crate adjusts a predicted like or dwell for how much that reader usually reacts.
whatChanged: Commit 52d4598 adds the source of a crate called xai-user-debias. It summarises a reader's recent actions over the last 1, 6, 24 and 168 hours. debiased_probability then moves a predicted probability by the gap between that reader and the global average, with the gap capped by a clip value. In the public config the switch is off by default, and one test arm turns it on for country DE at alpha 1.0. Live settings can differ.
meaningForCreators: A like from someone who likes almost everything may carry less weight in the guess about that reader, and a reaction from someone who rarely reacts may say more. That is a reading of the math, not something X has stated, and it only applies where the switch is on.
action: Do this: look at who reacts to your posts, and write more of what makes rare reactors stop.
